name: CheckInFile
description: Checks in a file in Microsoft 365 SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API, optionally with a comment and check-in type.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate and check in files in SharePoint via Microsoft Graph API.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint file URL to check in (e.g., https://company.sharepoint.com/sites/SiteName/Shared Documents/File.txt).

fields.name: Comment
fields.label: Check-In Comment
fields.description: Optional comment describing the changes made to the file.

fields.name: CheckInType
fields.label: Check-In Type
fields.description: Specifies the type of check-in. Options: Minor, Major, Simple.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: Returns metadata of the checked-in file, including ID, URL, check-in status, and applied comment.
